CustomField.label: Check Title
CustomField.description: The name end users see for this check in the card row on the record page. Required on every check. This is the friendly, user-facing title only - it is NOT the record's Label or Record Name (DeveloperName) shown in Setup. Keep it short, specific, and plain-language so a user immediately understands what was checked, e.g. "Billing City present".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required. The title users see for this check on the record page, e.g. "Billing City present". Keep it short and plain. Separate from the record's Setup Name/Label.
